title: UAT-11587 Antino Backdoor & Microsoft 365 API C2

steps.title: Spearphishing with HTML preview clones
steps.text: Targets receive spearphishing emails with HTML attachment-preview clones linking to Cloudflare-hosted files.
steps.description: Targets receive spearphishing emails with HTML attachment-preview clones linking to Cloudflare-hosted files.

steps.title: User executes staged HTA/WSF
steps.text: User interaction launches HTA/WSF staging scripts.
steps.description: User interaction launches HTA/WSF staging scripts.

steps.title: In-memory .NET deserialization
steps.text: Encrypted JavaScript/.NET payloads are deserialized and executed in memory.
steps.description: Encrypted JavaScript/.NET payloads are deserialized and executed in memory.

steps.title: DLL sideloading via signed utility
steps.text: A signed utility (GatherOsState.exe) sideloads a malicious slc.dll.
steps.description: A signed utility (GatherOsState.exe) sideloads a malicious slc.dll.

steps.title: PowerShell proxying and sleep masking
steps.text: sdiagnhost.exe proxies PowerShell execution and the backdoor uses sleep masking to evade detection.
steps.description: sdiagnhost.exe proxies PowerShell execution and the backdoor uses sleep masking to evade detection.

steps.title: Microsoft 365 API command-and-control
steps.text: The Antino backdoor polls Outlook (~every 10s) and OneDrive (~every minute) via OAuth for tasking.
steps.description: The Antino backdoor polls Outlook (~every 10s) and OneDrive (~every minute) via OAuth for tasking.

steps.title: Detect sideloading and M365 API C2
steps.text: Blue team detects GatherOsState.exe loading an unexpected slc.dll and anomalous OAuth polling of Outlook/OneDrive.
steps.description: Blue team detects GatherOsState.exe loading an unexpected slc.dll and anomalous OAuth polling of Outlook/OneDrive.

steps.title: Contain and evict the backdoor
steps.text: SOC isolates hosts, revokes OAuth grants/tokens, removes persistence and hunts for lateral movement.
steps.description: SOC isolates hosts, revokes OAuth grants/tokens, removes persistence and hunts for lateral movement.
